A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same XSkill study, with 27 readable pages including Appendices A–D. Pages 2–27 have identical extracted text and rendered images; first-page differences are confined to date/version information.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons in Table 2, component ablations in Table 3, transfer experiments, and open-source model evaluations in Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the benchmark comparisons, ablations, transfer experiments, and Appendix A evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains identical dual-stream knowledge accumulation, consolidation, task-decomposed retrieval, visual adaptation, and injection procedures. The corresponding prompts in Appendix C are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use VisualToolBench, TIR-Bench, MMSearch-Plus, MMBrowseComp, and AgentVista, with identical task coverage and cross-task transfer scenarios. MMBrowseComp remains exclusively an out-of-distribution evaluation target.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 5 retain the same no-tool, tool-only, AWM, Dynamic CheatSheet, and Agent-KB comparators. Comparator membership in the Figure 5 transfer experiments is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset filtering and splits, available tools, evaluated backbones, Average@4 and Pass@4 metrics, and inference budgets remain identical in Section 3.1 and Tables 1 and 6–8.

E4.justification: The component ablations, tool-error and tool-usage analyses, rollout sensitivity study, cross-task transfer experiments, and Appendix D case studies are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report four independent evaluation rollouts and dataset partition seed 42. Neither introduces confidence intervals, statistical error bars, significance tests, or additional uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative cases are unchanged. For example, Table 2 reports Gemini-3-Flash TIR-Bench Average@4 of 47.75% for XSkill and 36.62% for Agent-KB in both versions; Appendix A results also match.

T1.justification: The skill and experience definitions, POMDP formulation, optimization objective, and Equations (1)–(5) in Section 2 are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about unifying visually grounded skills and experiences, improving performance without parameter updates, and supporting zero-shot transfer.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including the complementary roles of skills and experiences, the single accumulation-then-test cycle limitation, and Appendix A's discussion of negative transfer effects on weaker models.

D1.justification: Appendices B–C retain identical hyperparameters, baseline configurations, tool definitions, and prompts. The project website and code repository links are unchanged; the updated arXiv version link supplies no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 4, the cited works, and the reference list are unchanged. The paper preserves its positioning relative to multimodal agentic reasoning and learning from experiences and skills.

P1.justification: The first-page preprint date changes from March 13, 2026 to July 2, 2026, and the arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated March 12 to v3 dated July 1. Body wording, section order, and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6, Tables 1–10, captions, and document layout are unchanged. Pages 2–27 render identically, and first-page visual differences are confined to the updated date/version lettering.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves all scientific content, experimental evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility details, including the appendices. The bibliographic and version updates do not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
